coupling_notes.T_attacker_unclassified_s: The current solver couples forward-corridor restriction, objective-edge assembly, candidate replay, and final selection. Stage 14.1 does not invent a finer split.
coupling_notes.T_defender_overhead_s: Derived from T_SSE minus shared graph and exact Attacker-BR wall times; it includes SSE follower tie-breaking and final leader comparison.
coupling_notes.T_graph_s: The canonical solver reuses one exact goal-backward graph. The shared build is timed once; tiny per-action prebuilt-graph access checks remain in the Attacker graph timer and are retained rather than reassigned.

timing_definitions.T_defender_overhead_s: leader/follower tie selection and loop overhead outside shared graph and Attacker-BR calls
timing_definitions.T_graph_s: shared goal-backward graph construction plus per-action graph access/build time
timing_definitions.T_hazard_s: sum of active-edge detection-hazard precomputation time
timing_definitions.T_switch_s: candidate generation + powered/energy filtering + virtual-connection processing
timing_definitions.T_validation_s: independent replay after T_SSE; excluded from T_SSE accounting

oracle_metadata.global_optimality_scope: exact exhaustive Stackelberg solution over the configured finite Defender actions, switching candidates, and Bellman lattice

convention.follower: maximize Defender PoD among Attacker-objective co-optima, then lowest candidate ID

coupling_notes.T_attacker_unclassified_s: The current solver couples forward-corridor restriction, objective-edge assembly, candidate replay, and final selection. Stage 14.1 does not invent a finer split.
coupling_notes.T_defender_overhead_s: Derived from T_SSE minus shared graph and exact Attacker-BR wall times; it includes SSE follower tie-breaking and final leader comparison.
coupling_notes.T_graph_s: The canonical solver reuses one exact goal-backward graph. The shared build is timed once; tiny per-action prebuilt-graph access checks remain in the Attacker graph timer and are retained rather than reassigned.
coupling_notes.T_switch_s: Reported both as a reliable aggregate and as candidate-generation, energy-filter, and virtual-connection subcomponents.

timing_definitions.T_defender_overhead_s: leader/follower tie selection and loop overhead outside shared graph and Attacker-BR calls
timing_definitions.T_graph_s: shared goal-backward graph construction plus per-action graph access/build time
timing_definitions.T_hazard_s: sum of active-edge detection-hazard precomputation time
timing_definitions.T_switch_s: candidate generation + powered/energy filtering + virtual-connection processing
timing_definitions.T_validation_s: independent replay after T_SSE; excluded from T_SSE accounting

convention.follower: maximize Defender PoD among Attacker-objective co-optima, then lowest candidate ID

coupling_notes.T_graph_s: The canonical solver reuses one exact goal-backward graph. The shared build is timed once; tiny per-action prebuilt-graph access checks remain in the Attacker graph timer and are retained rather than reassigned.
coupling_notes.T_switch_s: Reported both as a reliable aggregate and as candidate-generation, energy-filter, and virtual-connection subcomponents.

coupling_notes.T_attacker_unclassified_s: The current solver couples forward-corridor restriction, objective-edge assembly, candidate replay, and final selection. Stage 14.1 does not invent a finer split.
coupling_notes.T_defender_overhead_s: Derived from T_SSE minus shared graph and exact Attacker-BR wall times; it includes SSE follower tie-breaking and final leader comparison.
coupling_notes.T_graph_s: The canonical solver reuses one exact goal-backward graph. The shared build is timed once; tiny per-action prebuilt-graph access checks remain in the Attacker graph timer and are retained rather than reassigned.
coupling_notes.T_switch_s: Reported both as a reliable aggregate and as candidate-generation, energy-filter, and virtual-connection subcomponents.

oracle_metadata.global_optimality_scope: exact exhaustive Stackelberg solution over the configured finite Defender actions, switching candidates, and Bellman lattice

state_and_game_size.N_C_unique_definition: unique physical switching positions after rounding map coordinates to 12 decimal places; diagnostic count only, no solver deduplication

convention.follower: maximize Defender PoD among Attacker-objective co-optima, then lowest candidate ID

coupling_notes.T_attacker_unclassified_s: The current solver couples forward-corridor restriction, objective-edge assembly, candidate replay, and final selection. Stage 14.1 does not invent a finer split.
coupling_notes.T_defender_overhead_s: Derived from T_SSE minus shared graph and exact Attacker-BR wall times; it includes SSE follower tie-breaking and final leader comparison.
coupling_notes.T_graph_s: The canonical solver reuses one exact goal-backward graph. The shared build is timed once; tiny per-action prebuilt-graph access checks remain in the Attacker graph timer and are retained rather than reassigned.
coupling_notes.T_switch_s: Reported both as a reliable aggregate and as candidate-generation, energy-filter, and virtual-connection subcomponents.

timing_definitions.T_Bellman_s: sum of additive Bellman numerical solve time
timing_definitions.T_LOS_s: sum of LOS/tangent geometry time over Defender actions

timing_definitions.T_attacker_unclassified_s: exact Attacker-BR residual: corridor setup, option replay/objective evaluation, selection, and other glue
timing_definitions.T_defender_overhead_s: leader/follower tie selection and loop overhead outside shared graph and Attacker-BR calls
timing_definitions.T_graph_s: shared goal-backward graph construction plus per-action graph access/build time
timing_definitions.T_hazard_s: sum of active-edge detection-hazard precomputation time
timing_definitions.T_switch_s: candidate generation + powered/energy filtering + virtual-connection processing
timing_definitions.T_validation_s: independent replay after T_SSE; excluded from T_SSE accounting

coupling_notes.T_attacker_unclassified_s: The current solver couples forward-corridor restriction, objective-edge assembly, candidate replay, and final selection. Stage 14.1 does not invent a finer split.
coupling_notes.T_defender_overhead_s: Derived from T_SSE minus shared graph and exact Attacker-BR wall times; it includes SSE follower tie-breaking and final leader comparison.
coupling_notes.T_graph_s: The canonical solver reuses one exact goal-backward graph. The shared build is timed once; tiny per-action prebuilt-graph access checks remain in the Attacker graph timer and are retained rather than reassigned.
coupling_notes.T_switch_s: Reported both as a reliable aggregate and as candidate-generation, energy-filter, and virtual-connection subcomponents.

coupling_notes.T_attacker_unclassified_s: The current solver couples forward-corridor restriction, objective-edge assembly, candidate replay, and final selection. Stage 14.1 does not invent a finer split.
coupling_notes.T_defender_overhead_s: Derived from T_SSE minus shared graph and exact Attacker-BR wall times; it includes SSE follower tie-breaking and final leader comparison.
coupling_notes.T_graph_s: The canonical solver reuses one exact goal-backward graph. The shared build is timed once; tiny per-action prebuilt-graph access checks remain in the Attacker graph timer and are retained rather than reassigned.
coupling_notes.T_switch_s: Reported both as a reliable aggregate and as candidate-generation, energy-filter, and virtual-connection subcomponents.

coupling_notes.T_attacker_unclassified_s: The current solver couples forward-corridor restriction, objective-edge assembly, candidate replay, and final selection. Stage 14.1 does not invent a finer split.
coupling_notes.T_defender_overhead_s: Derived from T_SSE minus shared graph and exact Attacker-BR wall times; it includes SSE follower tie-breaking and final leader comparison.
coupling_notes.T_graph_s: The canonical solver reuses one exact goal-backward graph. The shared build is timed once; tiny per-action prebuilt-graph access checks remain in the Attacker graph timer and are retained rather than reassigned.
coupling_notes.T_switch_s: Reported both as a reliable aggregate and as candidate-generation, energy-filter, and virtual-connection subcomponents.
